about: Tunable physics constants, one row each. A [physics_params] table in an experiment may set any row here; nothing else is settable. A kernel-literal row names the exact source text it edits and how many times that text occurs, so a kernel edit that moves the literal refuses instead of silently disconnecting the constant. A table-multiplier row scales one column of one parameter table for the listed categories, applied after the table's pinned-hash check. With no [physics_params] table nothing here is read by a forecast: every kernel source and every table is today's, byte for byte.

constants.name: mynn.czil
constants.description: Zilitinkevich thermal-roughness coefficient over land: zt = z0 exp(-0.4 Czil sqrt(Re*)). Sets the heat-exchange roughness, so the daytime sensible heat flux and the 2 m temperature range.

constants.name: mynn.prandtl
constants.description: Neutral turbulent Prandtl number pr of the MYNN closure. It sets a2 = a1 (g1 - c1) / (g1 pr) and every closure constant derived from a2, so the ratio of heat to momentum diffusivity.
constants.host_mirror: gpuwm/core/mynn_pbl.py PR (CPU reference only; the forecast's device path reads the kernel literal)

constants.name: mynn.cns
constants.description: Stable surface-layer mixing-length coefficient cns of mym_length CASE(1): els = 0.4 z / (1 + cns min(z/L, 1)). Larger values shorten the mixing length at night, so it decides whether wind aloft reaches valley floors at night and how far RH recovers.

constants.name: mynn.alp1
constants.description: Turbulent length scale coefficient alp1 of mym_length CASE(1): elt = alp1 * (TKE-weighted mean height of the boundary layer). Sets the daytime mixing length, so how deep dry air is mixed down and how strong afternoon gusts can be.

constants.name: mynn.edmf_entrainment
constants.description: Lateral entrainment coefficient of the MYNN-EDMF dry and moist updrafts: ent = c / (min(max(w, wmin), 0.9) L). Larger values weaken the plumes, so afternoon mixed-layer growth and drying.

constants.name: ruc.z0.tall
constants.description: Multiplier on the RUC VEGPARM roughness length Z0 of forests, woody savanna, wooded wetland and urban categories. Seasonal-crop categories (IFOR 7) are excluded because the RUC surface kernel subtracts up to 0.125 m from their table roughness.

constants.name: ruc.z0.short
constants.description: Multiplier on the RUC VEGPARM roughness length Z0 of shrubland, savanna, grassland and barren categories. Seasonal-crop categories (IFOR 7) are excluded because the RUC surface kernel subtracts up to 0.125 m from their table roughness.

constants.name: ruc.rs
constants.description: Multiplier on the RUC VEGPARM minimum stomatal resistance RS of every vegetated category. Transpiration, so latent heat, 2 m dewpoint and afternoon RH.
